$comment: Maps trigger-prompt source files to their Snipset database slots. Source of truth is the markdown file; the database is a derived copy. Run `bun run snippets:check` in CI to catch drift, `bun run snippets:push` to update the database. Normalization rules are documented in scripts/sync-snippets.mjs and must match on both sides, so em dashes and arrow glyphs in the source do not create false drift. A NEW slot is a one-time create, not an update: `snipset snippet update` only works on a uuid that already exists, so provision it once with `snipset snippet add --name <name> --keyword <keyword> --group 'Agentic Coding AI' --description <description> --content "$(bun -e "import {readFileSync} from 'fs'; import {extractPromptBody} from './scripts/sync-snippets.mjs'; process.stdout.write(extractPromptBody(readFileSync('<source>','utf8')))")"`, then paste the returned uuid here and run `bun run snippets:push`. The uuid is chosen by the database, not by this file, so it cannot be pre-generated. Prerequisite: `snipset doctor` must report `schema_match: true`, otherwise every write is refused with 'schema mismatch: unexpected columns' and the slot cannot be created at all.

snippets.name: Debug Agent Prompt
snippets.description: RCA + WAJIB hypothesis-parallel subagent fan-out, learning harvest, graphify sync. Source: vivera/snippets/orkestrasi-debugging.md

snippets.name: PR Delivery and Batch Merge
snippets.description: Isolated worktree + branch, one PR per session, derived naming via pr-registry, topological batch merge with per-merge rebase and local verification, debt sweep with learning harvest, graphify sync. Source: vivera/snippets/orkestrasi-pr.md

snippets.name: PR Review Standalone
snippets.description: Review-only by default; merges to main only when pre-authorized and every safe gate passes (correct verdict, green checks, mergeable), graphify sync. Target comes from #{clipboard}: copy one PR URL, or several for a batch of any size. Source: vivera/snippets/orkestrasi-pr-review.md

snippets.name: Brainstorm Intent Lock
snippets.description: Grill-until-locked brainstorm BEFORE any plan: grounds in repo, asks via question tool, locks tasks A/B/C/D into approved intent, graphify sync. Source: vivera/snippets/orkestrasi-brainstorm.md

snippets.name: Overnight Run to PR
snippets.description: Approved plan to a verified PR while you are away: entry gate, retry budget, never merges, morning handoff file. Target comes from #{clipboard}: copy the approved plan path. Source: vivera/snippets/orkestrasi-overnight.md

snippets.name: Merge Now
snippets.description: Authorizes merging this session PR(s) into main: re-measured gates, one at a time in registry order, never --admin or --force, no deploy or cleanup. Source: vivera/snippets/cmd-merge.md

snippets.name: Continue Past a Failure
snippets.description: Keep going after an error without blind retries: classify the failure, 2 attempts per chunk, then park as blocked and continue independent chunks. Source: vivera/snippets/cmd-error-continue.md

snippets.name: Approved, Carry to Completion
snippets.description: Answers a check-in: finish every reversible step inside the approved scope, stop only for destructive, external, or scope-changing actions. Source: vivera/snippets/cmd-approved.md

snippets.name: Done on My Side, Verify
snippets.description: After a manual step by the user: measure the real state read-only, with a positive control, and separate measured from inferred. Source: vivera/snippets/cmd-done-verify.md

snippets.name: Status Check
snippets.description: Read-only status table from the plan checklist, the PR registry, and the job log: done, running, blocked, waiting on the user. Source: vivera/snippets/cmd-status.md

snippets.name: Resume From the Plan File
snippets.description: Rebuild state from the plan file, git status, the diff, and the PR registry; recover from an interrupted turn; continue at the last verified checkpoint. Source: vivera/snippets/cmd-resume.md

snippets.name: Clean Up After the Merge
snippets.description: Remove only this session worktree and local branch once the PR is merged and the branch is in origin/main; by PID, never rm -rf, remote branches untouched. Source: vivera/snippets/cmd-cleanup.md

snippets.name: Read-Only Audit
snippets.description: Assess and recommend without changing anything: measured findings apart from guesses, ranked proposals with revert paths. Source: vivera/snippets/cmd-audit.md

snippets.name: Review and Merge If Safe
snippets.description: Type after prr: the explicit pre-authorization that lets prr merge each PR that passes every AUTO-MERGE gate. Source: vivera/snippets/cmd-review-merge.md

snippets.name: Fallback When a Tool Fails
snippets.description: Fallback ladder (skill, TinyFish, question tool) and the stop rule for environment boundaries; never substitute a local run for a remote one. Source: vivera/snippets/cmd-fallback.md
